title: get_codey_playbook
description: Read-only. CALL THIS FIRST in a new conversation about Enterprise Sales Management (ESM) setup. Returns the Project Codey playbook (routing, golden rules), a skill (topic=skill:fresh-install|settings-health-check|permissions|upgrade-check|concepts-guide|pricing|customization|bulk-members), a runbook (runbook:US-01..US-11), a concept (concept:<key>, add quoteId for real examples from the org), the recommended settings (settings) or the release change list (releases); topic=index lists all. Follow the skill it routes to. Golden rules: look first; every change is mode=preview, show the Approval card, wait for an explicit yes, then mode=commit with the previewToken and the SAME inputs; secrets never in chat; keep replies short.

topic.description: overview, routing, rules, skill:<name>, runbook:US-01..US-11, concept:<key> or concept:all, settings, releases, index.

quoteId.description: Optional quote Id or name for real examples in concept answers.

surface.description: Where the request comes from, for example Agentforce or Coworker.

message.description: Plain-language result to tell the person.

previewToken.description: Returned by a preview; pass it back with mode=commit and the same inputs only after the person approved.

fix.description: How to resolve a problem when success is false.
